items.q: What should you remember about **Healthiest self in relationships**?
items.a: **Show up with maximum agency** and gratitude; relationships amplify structure/function of self, not replace inner work.

items.q: What should you remember about **Generative drive matching**?
items.a: Romantic success correlates with partners whose generative drives are strong and compatible; aggressive/pleasure drives should **subserve** generative drive, not dominate.

items.q: What should you remember about **Trauma bonds reframed**?
items.a: **Not inherently bad; two people bonded through shared** trauma can heal together if both work toward generative living; pathology when trauma keeps bond exploitative.

items.q: What should you remember about **Libido as generative expression**?
items.a: **Sexual energy in healthy partnerships** reflects generative giving/receiving; avoidance often signals unprocessed barriers, not mere preference.

items.q: What should you remember about **Repetition compulsion**?
items.a: **Fourth abusive relationship in a row** = unconscious pattern, not bad luck; requires ten cupboards exercise before choosing again.

items.q: What should you remember about **Narcissism + dependence**?
items.a: **Exploitative character structure draws pathological dependence; demoralization** on one side, bottomless need on other; not a fixable "us" without individual work.

items.q: What should you remember about **Jealousy ≠ envy**?
items.a: **Jealousy = fear of losing something valued;** envy = entitled taking/destruction (walking into friend's house to ruin privacy); envy lens predicts exploitation.

items.q: What should you remember about **Giving vs taking audit**?
items.a: **Healthy relationships trend generative-giving;** chronic taking without reciprocity signals no real "us.".

items.q: What should you remember about **Transactions vs relationships**?
items.a: **Kindergarten-level tit-for-tat ("you didn't share** your snack") is not adult relating; flexibility and generative intent matter.

items.q: What should you remember about **Anxiety in relationships**?
items.a: **Communicate from self-awareness; if activated/triggered, defer conflict** ("can we talk later?") — last time to make conclusions when you can't mentalize.

items.q: What should you remember about **Magic bridge of the us**?
items.a: **Me + you + shared generative space;** when you feel "us" but they don't, immense power in recognizing mismatch and self-protecting.

items.q: What should you remember about **Mentalization order**?
items.a: **Start with me (map/cupboards), then you,** then us; thinking about other before self = fool's errand; mentalization greases all progress.
